# Parcel Locker Network: Product Requirements

## Background

Couriers in the pilot city deliver to about six thousand homes a day. Roughly one delivery in nine fails because nobody is home.

## Expected outcomes

Once lockers are live at the five busiest transit stops, failed first-time deliveries will drop by a third within two quarters.

Recipients will collect parcels more often on weekdays because the lockers sit on their commute.

We expect that merchants who offer locker pickup are likely to see fewer "where is my order" contacts.

Competing couriers are expected to copy the locker model within a year of our launch.

## Plan and requirements

We will install the first twelve lockers in the third quarter.

Each locker must hold a parcel for at least 72 hours.

The target for the pilot is 40,000 parcels collected per month.

The depot closes at 18:00, so nothing will leave the depot after that time.

As a recipient I want a pickup code so that I can collect my parcel without waiting in a queue.
